cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "name must not be null"
cases.description: Verifies that findExactMatch throws an IllegalArgumentException when the supplied Name argument is null.
Ensures that an illegal DNS type value causes Type.check to throw an IllegalArgumentException, which propagates out of findExactMatch.
When the zone does not contain an RRset for the given name/type, findExactMatch should return null.

Adds an RRset to the Zone, then calls findExactMatch with the same name/type. The method must return a new RRset instance (different object identity) that contains the same records as the original, proving the copy‑on‑read behaviour.
After obtaining the copy, mutate the original RRset (e.g., add a new Record). The returned copy must remain unchanged, confirming that a deep copy was created rather than a reference to the original.

group: Exact match with distinct Name instance

cases.description: Adds an RRset to the zone, creates a new Name object with the same textual representation, calls findExactMatch and verifies that the returned RRset is a copy (different object) but has identical contents.
Ensures DNS name matching is case‑insensitive: an RRset added under lower‑case name is retrieved using an upper‑case variant.

group: Exact match when multiple types exist for same name

properties.name: multi.example.com.
properties.recordsCount: same as original for type A

cases.description: Adds two RRsets with the same name but different types (e.g., MX=15 and A=1). Calls findExactMatch for each type and verifies that the correct RRset is returned for each, demonstrating that the method does not confuse different types.

group: No match when name exists but type differs

cases.description: An RRset for name "host.example.com." with type A (1) is present, but the query asks for MX (15). findExactMatch must return null because the exact type is not stored.

group: Exact match after removal returns null

cases.description: Adds an RRset, verifies findExactMatch returns a copy, removes the RRset with removeRRset, then calls findExactMatch again and expects null.
Adds an RRset that contains no records (empty RRset). findExactMatch should still return a new RRset instance with zero records.

Uses the highest possible DNS type value (65535). Assuming the zone does not contain such a type, findExactMatch must return null and must not throw an exception, confirming that Type.check accepts the upper bound.

group: Boundary type value just above valid range

cases.description: Ensures that a type value just beyond the valid DNS type range triggers Type.check to throw IllegalArgumentException.
